paper_metadata.title: The Microstructure Stability of Precipitation Strengthened Medium to High Entropy Superalloys

evidence.quote: Medium and high entropy superalloys based on the Ni-Co-Fe system with strengthening L1 2 c¢ precipitates have been developed.

process_steps.input_state: pure elements Ni, Al, Co, Fe, Cr, Ti

evidence.quote: All alloys have been prepared by vacuum-arc-melting process. A total of 50 g pure Ni, Al, Co, Fe, Cr, Ti (purity better than 99 wt pct) were melted according to each individual ratio in high-purity argon atmosphere and solidified in a water-cooled copper mold. Samples were turned and re-melted more than 4 times to assure chemical homogeneity.
